services.name: Signature Atelier Cut & Finish
services.note: Tailored consultation, warm rosemary scalp cleanse, precision wet-and-dry cut, and soft natural blowout.

services.name: Lived-In Dimensional Balayage
services.note: Hand-painted sun-softened ribbons using clay lightener, bond-building complex, and customised gloss.

services.name: Ammonia-Free Botanical Gloss
services.note: Translucent Demi-permanent colour glaze enriched with cold-pressed camellia oil for mirror shine and tone balance.

services.name: Cedar & Hinoki Scalp Ritual
services.note: Micro-mist steam exfoliation, acupressure meridian massage, and mineral clay mask to rebalance scalp flora.

services.name: Amino Lipid Strand Infusion
services.note: Warm towel lipid-and-peptide reconstruction tailored for Bengaluru hard-water dryness and frizz control.

services.name: Sculptural Buccal & Lymphatic Facial
services.note: Slow-tempo myofascial release, intra-oral tension relief, and chilled rose-quartz drainage to lift and depuff.

services.name: Ceramide Barrier Recovery Ritual
services.note: Gentle enzymatic polish, oat-milk cryo compress, and triple-ceramide infusion for sensitised or reactive skin.

services.name: Botanical Lactic & LED Illumination
services.note: Mild fermented fruit acid resurfacing paired with medical-grade amber LED therapy for even luminosity.

services.name: Nephrite Gua Sha & Oxygen Dew
services.note: Rhythmic jade contour massage over squalane nectar followed by hyperbaric botanical mist infusion.

services.name: Midday Pore & Hydration Reset
services.note: Ultrasonic congestion clearing, hyaluronic sheet compress, and calming blue-tansy finish with zero downtime.

services.name: Structured Japanese Gel Manicure
services.note: Dry e-file cuticle refinement, flexible HEMA-free builder base, and sheer neutral or milky stone tint.

services.name: Warm Basalt & Vetiver Pedicure
services.note: Copper-bowl vetiver soak, gentle pumice smoothing, heated basalt calf massage, and breathable polish.

services.name: Bare Nail Beeswax Buff & Oil
services.note: Precision shaping, micro-cuticle tidy, natural beeswax high-lustre buff, and warm almond hand wrap.

services.name: Bespoke Brow Architecture & Tint
services.note: Bone-structure mapping, gentle cotton threading, vegetable-dye brow tint, and soothing aloe-chamomile balm.
